items.title: File Klage against the operating-hours order with the Verwaltungsgericht
items.quote: Innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe kann gegen diesen Bescheid Klage beim Verwaltungsgericht Musterarnsberg, Jägerstraße 1, 59821 Musterarnsberg, erhoben werden.
items.computation: The letter embodying the Bescheid is dated Thu 19.11.2026 (the Bescheid itself is dated 18.11.2026, one day earlier, inside the text). Taking the later, letter-printed date as the posting day (19.11.2026) and applying the authority deemed-delivery rule (§41 Abs.2 VwVfG, 4 days after posting, no weekend shift of the delivery day itself): delivery is deemed to occur on Mon 23.11.2026. The one-month Klage period (§74 VwGO) starts the day after delivery (§187 Abs.1 BGB) and ends one month later on the same numbered day (§188 Abs.2 BGB): Wed 23.12.2026. That day is a normal working day in NRW, so no further shift applies.

warnings: The letter refers to a 'Bescheid vom 18.11.2026' but the covering letter itself is dated 19.11.2026 - worth checking whether the one-day gap affects when the notice actually counts as delivered; the computed deadline (23.12.2026) assumes the 19.11.2026 letter date is the relevant posting day, which is the earlier, safer assumption.

This is a deadline for filing a court action (Klage) with the Verwaltungsgericht, not a simple objection - get advice (e.g. a lawyer or Verbraucherzentrale) well before the deadline if you intend to contest the order.

The deemed-delivery calculation assumes ordinary postal delivery; if the letter was actually served by registered mail or with proof of service (e.g. a yellow envelope), the period could start on a different, possibly earlier, date - check the envelope.
